findings.message: Review was source- and screenshot-based. I did not open the T6 check report files or the SDK records, and I ran no commands. Browser results come from existing runner and screenshot artifacts under /home/user/probes/web-todo/.autodev/evidence, plus the parent's PASS task states. Console-error absence and reload persistence are not independently re-observed by me. The parent's final verify must confirm them.

failure_state shows earlier failures for T1 to T6 (T1 has 2, the others 1), all with repair_attempt 0 and no blocker. The tasks are now PASS, but the failure history stays visible. The Opus final audit has not run yet; that is a later stage.

The 375px populated-all screenshot (T6-visual-375-7f4ed384...-populated-all.png) shows the layout is usable. A long unbroken string wraps inside the row and the delete button stays visible. The done item has a strikethrough and the counter reads '2 items left'. I viewed only this one screenshot.
